title: Twitch VOD Session Peak Viewers Leaderboard
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr/Radarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=twitch:vod viewer_peak=*
| stats sum(viewer_peak) as total_value, avg(viewer_peak) as avg_value by channel
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks channel values by total and average peak viewers across Twitch VOD session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `viewer_peak` values for each Twitch VOD session event and review total and average peak viewers by channel.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total peak viewers.
grandmaExplanation: It will map which channel shows the biggest peak viewers numbers in your Twitch VOD session data.
